name: Freesurfer 7.1.1 Longitudinal (Step 2/2)
summary: Runs FreeSurfer 7.1.1 recon-all -long on one timepoint against the longitudinal base template from Step 1/2, producing a longitudinally processed FreeSurfer output; step 2 of 2.
description: Copies the timepoint FreeSurfer output, the base template and the other timepoints into a subjects directory and runs recon-all -long <timepoint> template -all. Run it once per timepoint after Step 1/2; the timepoint must be one of those used to build the template (identified by the md5 of mri/norm.mgz). Requires a FreeSurfer license. See https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/FsTutorial/LongitudinalTutorial

inputs.description: Cross-sectional FreeSurfer output of one timepoint to process longitudinally.
inputs.requirements: Must be one of the timepoints used to create the template (matched by md5 of mri/norm.mgz).

inputs.description: Longitudinal base template geneerated by "Longitudinal Template" App.

outputs.description: FreeSurfer subject directory of the longitudinally processed timepoint (<timepoint>.long.template).

parameters.description: Fixed to long: makes main run long.sh (recon-all -long). Do not change.
